description_en: A management account or a delegated administrator account in a resource directory can create an account group to centrally manage resources, compliance packages, and rules across multiple member accounts
description_zh: 资源目录中的管理账号或委派管理员账号可以创建账号组，在账号组中集中地管理多个成员的资源、合规包和规则
kebab_example: aliyun config create-aggregator --aggregator-name Example_Aggregator --description Example_aggregator_used_to_demonstrate_how_to_create_an_aggregator. --aggregator-accounts AccountId=1713220985230000 AccountType=ResourceDirectory AccountName=Alice --client-token 1594295238-f9361358-5843-4294-8d30-b5183fac0000 --aggregator-type CUSTOM --folder-id fd-brHdgv0000,fd-brHdgk0000 --tag Value=value-1 Key=key-1 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAggregator

parameters.help_en: The name of the account group
parameters.name: aggregator_name

parameters.example: Example aggregator used to demonstrate how to create an aggregator.
parameters.help_en: The description of the account group
parameters.name: description

element_fields.help_en: The member ID. For more information about how to obtain the member ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
element_fields.help_zh:
成员ID。
关于如何获取成员ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
element_fields.name: account_id

element_fields.help_en: The member name. For more information about how to obtain the member name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
element_fields.help_zh:
成员名称。

element_fields.help_en: The affiliation of the member. Only `ResourceDirectory` is supported
element_fields.help_zh: 成员归属。仅支持`ResourceDirectory`（资源目录）
element_fields.name: account_type

parameters.help_en:
The member accounts of the account group.

If you set `AggregatorType` to `RD, you can leave this parameter empty. This indicates that all members in the resource directory are added to the global account group.

If you set `AggregatorType` to `FOLDER`, you can leave this parameter empty. This indicates that all members in a specific folder in the resource directory are added to the folder account group
parameters.help_zh:
账号组内的所有成员账号。

当`AggregatorType`为`RD时，该参数可以为空，表示将资源目录中的所有成员添加至全局账号组。
当`AggregatorType`为`FOLDER`时，该参数可以为空，表示将资源目录中某个资源夹中的所有成员添加至资源夹账号组
parameters.name: aggregator_accounts

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You must make sure that the token is unique for different requests. The `ClientToken` parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of the account group. Valid values:

RD: global account group.

FOLDER: folder account group. You must also set the `FolderId` parameter. For more information about how to obtain a folder ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html.

CUSTOM (default): custom account group. You must also set the `AccountId` and `AccountType` parameters for `AggregatorAccounts`
parameters.help_zh:
账号组类型。取值：
RD：全局账号组。
FOLDER：资源夹账号组。必须同时设置`FolderId`。关于如何获取资源夹ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html。
CUSTOM（默认值）：自定义账号组。必须同时设置`AggregatorAccounts`中的`AccountId`和`AccountType`
parameters.name: aggregator_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the attached folder. You can specify multiple folder IDs. Separate the IDs with commas (,).

This parameter is required if you set `AggregatorType` to `FOLDER`
parameters.help_zh:
绑定的资源夹ID。支持多值，多个资源夹ID之间用半角逗号(,)分隔

当`AggregatorType`为`FOLDER`时，必须设置本参数
parameters.name: folder_id

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify a maximum of 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http\:// or https\://
element_fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:

element_fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value
